title: Invitation group templates persist and generate reviewable drafts without overwriting approved emails
steps: Run the real PostgreSQL sandbox route tests and template renderer tests against an isolated test database.
Run the mounted Invitations screen and navigation tests with synthetic API responses.
expect: Five groups keep independent immutable template versions; a fresh route read returns persisted content and preview is read-only.
Missing required templates reject generation atomically; preview and generated drafts use the same renderer.
Default generation preserves customized and approved snapshots; explicit replacement clears approval and blocked or attempted recipients cannot be overwritten.
Linked-identity suppression prevents generation, customization and approval across campaigns.
Saving group two retains selection; generation opens Review emails filtered to that group.
Failed saves and cancelled navigation preserve unsaved edits; confirmed reload of the selected campaign discards them consistently.
Review lists drafts, Conversations lists messages, and Import describes recipient CSV rather than templates.
fence: Real database route persistence plus deterministic mounted UI; no production mailbox, real customer data or shared QA database.

tests: group content versions survive fresh route reads without changing existing snapshots
content versions persist independently across five groups and preview is read-only
generation requires assigned content atomically and uses the preview renderer
template edits and default generation preserve approved custom drafts; explicit replacement resets approval
regeneration and customization leave blocked recipients and any attempted snapshot untouched
individual customization and approval reject program suppression without writing the campaign
saving group two keeps its selection and generation posts that group then opens Review emails
unsaved edits block approval and sandbox, survive a failed save, and cancel tab navigation
reopening the current campaign discards template edits only after confirmation
Review lists drafts, Conversations lists recorded messages, and Import describes recipients
cancelled Back restores its history position without a second confirmation
